CREATE TABLE "public"."socialInboxConversation" (
  "connectionId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "contactId" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "externalConversationId" character varying(255),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isArchived" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lastMessageAt" timestamptz,
  "snoozedUntil" timestamptz,
  "statusId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "subject" character varying(255),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."socialInboxConversationAssignment" (
  "assignedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "assignedByUserId" uuid,
  "conversationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "unassignedAt" timestamptz,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."socialInboxConversationRead" (
  "conversationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastReadAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "lastReadMessageId" uuid,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."socialInboxConversationStatus" (
  "code" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."socialInboxConversationTag" (
  "conversationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "tagId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."socialInboxMessage" (
  "content" text,
  "conversationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "direction" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "externalMessageId" character varying(255),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "messageTypeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "replyToMessageId" uuid,
  "senderContactId" uuid,
  "senderUserId" uuid,
  "sentAt" timestamptz,
  "statusId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."socialInboxMessageStatus" (
  "code" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."socialInboxMessageType" (
  "code" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
